{{Quote|Glad to share my skills with someone talented.|Muheeda|<ref name="The Arm" />}}
'''Muheeda''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="The Arm" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Fair-skinned with [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and gray [[Hair/Legends|hair]], Muheeda sported facial hair in sections on both sides of their [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. Trained as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] with a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the Jedi Master became a [[Jedi instructor|combat instructor]] on Tython and could often be found in the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Archives]] of the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Muheeda employed the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Aven (Jedi)|Aven]] to inform new students that Muheeda was willing to teach them in the use of both lightsabers and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="The Arm" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Arm That Holds the Saber|Tython}} is part of the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] Prologue of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which in turn takes place in [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates|here]].</ref> Aven told a [[Hero of Tython|young initiate]]<ref name="The Arm" />&mdash;the future [[Hero of Tython]]<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>&mdash;to learn new skills from Muheeda.<ref name="The Arm" /> Muheeda carved the names of fallen Jedi into the hilt of their lightsaber as a constant reminder of the cost of aggression.<ref name="TORE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Muheeda.png|thumb|left|120px|Muheeda's previous appearance]]
Muheeda first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], as the skill trainer for the Jedi Knight class on the starting planet of Tython. They initially appeared as a green-skinned [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] until the release of Game Update 1.2, when he was changed to a Human male. In the mission "The Arm That Holds the Saber," which Jedi Knight players acquire upon arriving at the Jedi Temple for the first time, Aven tells players to meet with Muheeda to learn new skills.<ref name="The Arm" /> Muheeda's location is also identified in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', released simultaneously with the game.<ref name="Explore">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
